description: This is a shell script file that appears to be a test harness for the Git trace2 facility, which includes various test cases to verify trace event streaming, nested process creation, configuration listing, environment variable listing, data collection, and URL redaction behaviors. It orchestrates calling a test tool with different parameters, parses generated event logs with a Perl script, and validates output against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a series of commands, and compares output with expected results.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or streams and reports differences.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests are completed.
